prior_exposure: Root previously read all 4,407 reports in the original corrective run and knows the historical 34 corrections and aggregate focused-queue/reader counts. First focused-reader discovery summaries exposed some examples and wording. This is an additional personally authored full-source reread, not first-ever blinding. Neither focused reader's case-specific source states, proposals, current effective labels or comparisons were opened for this pass. The neutral manifest and packets 000 and 001 were personally read, besides the frozen rubric. The first ten-report source freeze already exists and remains unchanged. Neither reader's case-specific assessments or comparisons have been opened.
scope: This second packet contains ten complete source rereads and 120 decisions; cumulative root coverage is 20 of 48 reports and 240 decisions. Not accepted corrections; no global gate closure; remaining 28 reports and all post-freeze comparisons remain pending.
